##### Project general facts

Amali Island is an exclusive collection of ultra-luxury beachfront villas by Amali, the developer founded by Ali and Amira Sajwani, set on two connected private islands and celebrating exquisite simplicity. Architecture by EL ASTIC, interiors by Hirsch Bedner Associates and landscaping by SquareM create residences that complement their beachfront setting. Four villa typologies, each in a Grande or Minima style, rise from a ground floor to two upper floors, offering five-, six- and seven-bedroom homes with sweeping sea and skyline views.

Life on the islands feels like a perpetual vacation. Every villa enjoys its own private beachfront, a private pool and a state-of-the-art private berth suitable for motor and sailing yachts. A members-only clubhouse reserved exclusively for residents brings together a restaurant, a spa and a cutting-edge fitness centre, while a helipad, a dedicated concierge and tranquil tree-lined pathways complete an experience of privacy, rejuvenation and effortless luxury.

Interiors are offered in two distinct aesthetics, allowing owners to choose between opulent, classic tones and modern, subtle, earthy hues, each featuring carefully sourced materials from around the world. Expansive living spaces open onto terraces and gardens with panoramic views of the sea, the city skyline and the coastline, while bedroom suites provide calm, private retreats. Villas are delivered unfurnished, giving owners the freedom to create a fully customised island home.

##### Location description and benefits

The World Islands are an iconic archipelago of man-made islands off the coast of Dubai, shaped like a map of the world and widely regarded as one of the most remarkable feats of engineering in the region. The islands offer unparalleled privacy and open sea views towards the Dubai skyline, Palm Jumeirah and Burj Khalifa, creating a rare island setting close to the city.

Residents reach the mainland by boat, with private wharves, the Jumeirah coastline and Madinat Jumeirah a short trip away, while the helipad offers swift access by air. Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Financial Centre, Deira, Dubai International Airport and the Jetex private terminal are all within easy reach of the islands, keeping the energy of the city close while home remains a secluded retreat surrounded by the sea.

The World Islands are a freehold destination offering one of the most exclusive addresses in Dubai. Private island villas with their own berths and beachfront are in extremely limited supply, attracting ultra-high-net-worth buyers seeking privacy and prestige. Scarcity, iconic views and proximity to the city's main business and leisure districts underpin long-term value and resale prospects for owners and investors.
